title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the Unit Forge schemas. Fields marked x-vocab must hold a term id from that vocabulary in data/vocab/; the validator checks this.

availability.means: has this availability (open, limited or unique)

damage.means: has a weapon that deals this damage

weapon.means: has a weapon of this family

passengers.means: has this many passenger seats (a number, usually with >= or <=)

mount.means: has a weapon on this mount

delivery.means: has a weapon with this delivery

range.means: has a weapon with this range

weapon-trait.means: has a weapon with this trait

target.means: is this kind of target (from its mobility and size)

hits.means: has a weapon that can hit this kind of target

sight.means: sees this far through the fog of war

nature.means: is organic, a crewed machine or an uncrewed machine

category.means: has an ability whose pattern is in this category

pattern.means: has this mechanic pattern (an id in data/patterns)

immune.means: is immune to this damage type, or to this pattern or mobility trait used on it (an id in damage-types, data/patterns or mobility-traits)

unit.means: is this source unit (research data only; never on a generated card)

ref.description: Typed link `<kind>:<id>`, e.g. `role:anti-air`, `size:<=small` or `hits:high-air`. A link always describes a unit. In strengths, weaknesses, requires, excludes and implies it describes this unit; in counters, the unit this one beats; in countered_by, the unit that beats this one; in combos, the teammate it works well with. The one exception is `target:structure` in counters and countered_by, which names enemy buildings. Kinds are listed under Conventions in docs/fields.md; ranked kinds accept `<=` and `>=`.

relation.description: A typed link plus a plain-words reason.

cnf.description: Conditions as groups of typed links: every group must hold, and one link in a group is enough.

classRarity.description: Rarity per class (class id to rarity id), used instead of the usual rarity when the unit is of that class. Every key must also be in the classes list beside it. Used for cross-overs: parts that are possible but unusual for a class are listed here as rare (or uncommon), so they appear only at higher spice. A faction's one-step bonus for favoured parts does not apply to a class rarity.

points.description: Weights for the generator's balance hints, 0-3 each. Proposed with the generator (Phase 2).

source.description: A citation. Paraphrase only; never copy text or images. When another established site covers the unit, cite it rather than a third page of the same site.

url.description: The page actually read (https only; never an image).

supports.description: Which fields this source backs, as paths such as 'tier', 'cost_band' or 'abilities/0'.

version.description: Patch, edition or remaster the page describes, for games that change.

review.description: Checker status. The research run samples entries and re-checks them against their sources.

fitNote.description: Where no vocabulary term fitted well. Collected into a vocabulary-gaps report that feeds the next vocabulary version.

path.description: Where the term would go, as a path with / between field names and list positions (armour/models, armament/2/damage). For something left out entirely, the list it would have gone in (abilities, armament).

uncertain.description: A specific point that is less certain than the overall confidence, or where sources disagree.

path.description: The field the doubt is about, as a path with / (sensors/sight, armament/0/range).
